evals.prompt: Run full lint suite on this Rust project
evals.expected_output: Runs clippy, fmt check, cargo audit, cargo deny, cargo machete in sequence
assertions: Runs cargo audit and cargo deny

evals.expected_output: Runs clippy with --fix flag, reports auto-fixed vs manual fixes needed
assertions: Reports warnings that couldn't be auto-fixed

evals.prompt: Check for security vulnerabilities in dependencies
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo audit and cargo deny check, reports findings with severity
assertions: Reports vulnerability severity and license issues

evals.prompt: Check if my code is properly formatted
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo fmt --check and reports unformatted files
assertions: Does not modify files in check mode

evals.prompt: Lint the entire workspace for unused dependencies
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo machete to find unused dependencies across all crates
assertions: Distinguishes between truly unused and build-only deps
